name: THE SHRiNK
source:
You play a 23-year-old, good for nothing deadbeat loser, who lives in a house full of women in a small town called Woodsville.

Life was always kinda quiet and uneventful there... that is until today. An outbreak, that began as the revenge story of an angry scientist getting back at her cheating husband, is about to hit your home town.

Coincidentally, today is also your birthday and you have decided it's time to make some changes in your life but the effects of this virus are set to change your life in ways you could never have imagined. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/OnemanVN]Patreon[/url]]
